description: CR 700.2d the second copy of a mode whose target is gone defines no object of its own
note: Synthetic Raising Refrain with its raising mode chosen twice, both instances aimed at the same Piker card in alice's graveyard. Occurrence 0 returns it, so occurrence 1's target no longer exists (CR 400.7) and it defines no risen object of its own; its counter clause then finds occurrence 0's permanent, and the 2/1 becomes a 3/2 rather than a 4/3. Alice's library is a Swamp, so the Piker on the battlefield is the only live one.
